execution.case_selection: exact ordered 17-case inventory from the contact prototype manifest
execution.controller: zero residual through the frozen reference tracker

reference_overlay.projected_values: exact bounded prototype artifact on relative frames 0 through 11
reference_overlay.outside_projected_window: unchanged reference values from the hash-closed V18 source corpus

fresh_scene.method: author root-link pose, root-link-derived center-of-mass world velocity and JointStateAPI position/velocity in a per-case USD layer before SimulationContext.reset; disable the already-authored ground collision only during two mandatory 1 ns Isaac initialization steps, re-enable it before contact-view creation, and restore 1/240 s before the episode

indexed_partial_reset.method: running-scene indexed root/joint writes followed by the root-link velocity writer

reset_comparison.impulse_delta_rationale: 0.01 N*s is at most one percent of the smallest 1 N*s hard-impact limit and one fifth of the 0.05 N*s active-contact impulse floor
reset_comparison.divergence_disposition: stop before full V19 and resolve reset semantics through the architecture workflow
reset_comparison.equivalence_disposition: retain ADR-070; indexed partial reset remains diagnostic-only and fresh-scene evidence remains required for acceptance

bounded_acceptance.targeted_failure_category_count_change: strict decrease for hard_impact, hard_rom and joint_velocity
bounded_acceptance.result_if_passed: permit a full V19 data build and fresh-scene optimizer-free gate; do not authorize optimization
